summary: Practise AI data minimization, privacy impact assessment and safeguard planning. Explore the course and strengthen your AI privacy reviews.
lede: Privacy-preserving AI training helps data protection officers, AI product managers and data architects assess privacy risks in AI workflows using sensitive or personal data. Participants practise mapping data flows, minimizing data collection, assessing re-identification risks and documenting safeguards through privacy impact assessments. The course also covers synthetic-data utility, federated-learning trade-offs and control responsibilities, using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001 as references.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make or review decisions about sensitive data in AI and analytics workflows. It is designed for practitioners who need to assess privacy risks, specify safeguards or explain data-use decisions to product, technical and governance teams.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Privacy Risk
prerequisites: Prior work with personal or sensitive data, privacy compliance, AI product development or analytics is useful. No programming is required; exercises use scenario materials and spreadsheet-based analysis.
